obfuscation_indicators: actual results could be materially different
risk_summary: The disclosure is detailed and includes quantified non-performing loan trends, but relies heavily on standard forward-looking disclaimers and judgment-based assumptions regarding loan-loss allowances, collateral values, OTTI, and goodwill impairment. Credit indicators improved year over year, although material exposure remains to borrower performance, real estate values, economic conditions, and the accuracy of credit-enhancement assumptions.
